caption: The drawing depicts a square textile with a woven pattern in red and off-white colors. The central area of the textile features a symmetrical design composed of large stylized star or floral motifs arranged in a grid, with smaller geometric and floral shapes filling the gaps between them. Along the right edge, there is a vertical border featuring repeated abstract and stepped shapes in both red and off-white. The bottom edge of the textile is finished with a series of short, evenly spaced fringe strands in red, suggesting the end of the fabric. The background is a plain, light beige, with no additional objects or details visible. The composition is centered, showing the textile occupying the main part of the image with some space around it. The artist's signature, "Tex Bush," is written in red ink in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
